situations.title: 사지 손상 초기 사정
situations.tagline: My arm looks bent and it's swelling up fast.
situations.brief: 사지 손상 환자의 변형·부종·압통·개방창을 체계적으로 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to look at and gently check your arm.
Is there any open cut or just swelling and bruising?
Tell me where it's most tender when I touch.

situations.title: 신경혈관(5P) 확인
situations.tagline: My fingers feel kind of numb below the injury.
situations.brief: 손상 원위부의 5P(맥박·감각·운동·색·통증)를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you feel me touching your fingers?
Wiggle your fingers and toes for me if you can.
I'm checking the pulse below your injury.

situations.title: 부목 고정 설명
situations.tagline: Why do you need to put that splint on my leg?
situations.brief: 부목 고정의 목적과 부동 유지 방법을 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The splint keeps the bone still so it can heal.
Please don't move or put weight on this leg.
Tell me if the splint feels too tight or numb.

situations.title: 통증 척도·기전 청취
situations.tagline: I fell off the ladder and landed on my wrist.
situations.brief: 손상 기전과 통증 양상·척도를 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: How did the injury happen exactly?
On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is the pain?
Is the pain sharp, throbbing, or dull?

situations.title: RICE·거상 교육
situations.tagline: What should I do at home for this sprained ankle?
situations.brief: 냉찜질·거상·압박·휴식(RICE) 자가관리를 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: Keep the ankle raised above your heart when resting.
Use ice for twenty minutes at a time, a few times a day.
Come back if the swelling or pain gets much worse.

situations.title: 개방골절 감염 예방
situations.tagline: I can see the bone through the cut—is that infected?
situations.brief: 개방골절의 피복·파상풍·항생제로 감염을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll cover the wound with a sterile dressing right away.
You'll get antibiotics to prevent infection.
When was your last tetanus shot?

situations.title: 원위부 맥박 소실 골절
situations.tagline: My foot below the break feels cold and I can't feel it.
situations.brief: 원위부 맥박 소실을 인지하고 혈관손상·긴급 정복을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: I can't feel a pulse in your foot, so we must act quickly.
The bone may be pressing on a blood vessel.
We're going to realign it to restore blood flow.
goals: 혈관 압박 해소를 위한 긴급 정복을 조율한다

situations.title: 관절 탈구 정복 준비
situations.tagline: My shoulder is out of place and I can't move it at all.
situations.brief: 진정 후 정복과 정복 후 신경혈관 재확인을 준비·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll give you medicine to relax before putting it back.
After we reset it, I'll recheck your pulse and feeling.
Try to stay relaxed—tensing makes it harder.

situations.title: 고관절 골절 고령
situations.tagline: I fell at home and now I can't stand on my leg.
situations.brief: 고령 고관절 골절 환자의 통증·수술 대기·섬망 예방을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll manage your pain while you wait for surgery.
Do you know where you are and what day it is?
We'll keep you oriented and comfortable tonight.

situations.title: 손가락 절단 이송
situations.tagline: They put my finger in a bag—can it be reattached?
situations.brief: 절단부를 습윤·냉장 보존하고 재접합 이송을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: We're keeping the finger cool and moist to protect it.
The specialist may be able to reattach it.
We'll control your bleeding while we prepare transfer.

situations.title: 항응고제 골절 혈종
situations.tagline: The swelling around my break is getting huge and dark.
situations.brief: 항응고제 복용 골절 환자의 출혈성 부종·혈종을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Because you take a blood thinner, the swelling can grow.
Which blood thinner do you take and when was the last dose?
We'll check the limb often for tightness and color.

situations.title: 소아 성장판 손상
situations.tagline: Will this hurt how my child's arm grows later?
situations.brief: 소아 성장판 손상의 성장 영향과 추적 필요성을 보호자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This injury is near the growth plate, so we watch it closely.
Most heal well, but follow-up is important for growth.
The specialist will check the alignment over time.
goals: 성장판 손상의 의미와 성장 영향을 설명한다

situations.title: 병적 골절 의심
situations.tagline: I barely bumped it and the bone just snapped.
situations.brief: 경미한 외상에 발생한 골절로 기저질환에 따른 병적 골절을 의심·문진하세요.
keyPhrases: This break happened with very little force, which is unusual.
Do you have any history of cancer or bone disease?
Have you had unexplained pain or weight loss recently?
goals: 저에너지 외상 대비 골절 정도를 평가한다

situations.title: 언어장벽 골절
situations.tagline: Ita... sakit... tidak bisa gerak.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자의 통증·알레르기·기왕력을 통역과 함께 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll get an interpreter so we understand each other.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
Point to where it hurts and show me how bad.
goals: 통역을 통해 통증 부위와 강도를 확인한다

situations.title: 석고붕대 후 교육
situations.tagline: How do I take care of this cast at home?
situations.brief: 석고붕대 후 압박·순환 경고 징후와 관리법을 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: Keep the cast dry and elevated to reduce swelling.
Come back if your fingers turn pale, numb, or very painful.
Never push anything inside the cast to scratch.
goals: 저림·창백·통증 등 순환 경고 징후를 안내한다

situations.title: 구획증후군 급속진행
situations.tagline: The pain is way worse than it should be and getting unbearable.
situations.brief: 손상 정도에 비해 불균형한 통증을 인지하고 응급 감압을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Pain out of proportion is a serious warning sign.
Does it hurt more when I stretch your fingers or toes?
We need surgery soon to relieve the pressure.

situations.title: 골반골절 혈역학 불안정
situations.tagline: My hips hurt so much and I feel like I'm going to faint.
situations.brief: 골반골절 환자에 바인더를 적용하고 대량출혈·수혈을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We're placing a binder to stabilize your pelvis and slow bleeding.
You may be bleeding internally, so we're giving you blood.
Try to stay still while we stabilize you.

situations.title: 대퇴골 골절 지방색전
situations.tagline: I suddenly feel short of breath and confused.
situations.brief: 대퇴골 골절 후 호흡곤란·점상출혈로 지방색전을 의심·보고하세요.
keyPhrases: New shortness of breath after this fracture concerns us.
I'm checking your oxygen and looking for a rash.
We're giving you oxygen and monitoring you closely.

situations.title: 다발 장골골절 출혈성 쇼크
situations.tagline: Both my legs are broken and I feel so cold and weak.
situations.brief: 다발 장골골절의 은닉 실혈을 사정하고 수혈을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Broken long bones can hide a lot of blood loss.
Your pressure is low, so we're starting a transfusion.
We'll splint your legs and keep you warm.

situations.title: 개방골절 SBAR 인계
situations.tagline: Orthopedics is calling back—what's the report?
situations.brief: 창상·신경혈관·항생제 상태를 SBAR로 정형외과에 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: This is an open tibia fracture with a five-centimeter wound.
Distal pulse is intact and sensation is normal.
Tetanus is updated and antibiotics were given at ten past.

situations.title: 외상성 절단 지혈대 관리
situations.tagline: You put that tight band on my leg—how long can it stay?
situations.brief: 외상성 절단부에 지혈대를 적용하고 적용 시각·재관류를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The tourniquet stops the bleeding and we noted the time.
We won't loosen it until it's safe to do so.
Tell me if the pain or numbness changes.
